case_title: CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO VS. EMMA CAROLINE NEALE ET AL

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO , A MUNICIPAL CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT NEALE, EMMA CAROLINE DOES 1 THORUGH 20, INCLUSIVE SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR FEB-20-2019 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  NOV-19-2018 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         JAN-28-2019
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF FEB-20-2019 CONTINUED TO APR-03-2019 AT 10:30 AM IN DEPARTMENT 610. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR MAY-14-2019 IN DEPARTMENT 610 AT 10:30 AM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE APR-03-2019 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE EACH PARTY TO BEAR OWN COSTS AND FEES. (TRANSACTION ID # 63078089)
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE OF MAY-14-2019 IS OFF CALENDAR. DISMISSAL ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
